project_type: Monorepo: Next.js 16 (App Router, TypeScript) web app in web/ + Python 3.12 FastAPI scraper in scraper/. Shared data today via ./data JSON/JSONL files on a Docker bind mount.
build_system: web: npm (web/package-lock.json, Dockerfile uses `npm ci`), Next.js build via `npm run build`. scraper: pip + requirements.txt. Orchestration via docker-compose.yml and ./dev.sh CLI. QUIRK: web/package.json currently has NO `test` script though README/CLAUDE say `npm test` works — add one. QUIRK: DATA_DIR must NOT live in web/src/lib/constants.ts (edge-runtime constraint per CLAUDE.md); the DB client must likewise never be imported into edge code (auth.config.ts / middleware). auth.ts is Node-runtime only and is the correct home for DB-backed user lookup.
test_framework: web: Jest + ts-jest (web/src/__tests__/, run `cd web && npm test`). scraper: pytest via `./dev.sh test` (16 tests), lint `./dev.sh lint` (ruff).
build_command: web: `cd web && npm run build` and `cd web && npm run lint`. scraper: `./dev.sh lint`.
test_command: web: `cd web && npm test`. scraper: `./dev.sh test`.
verification_instructions: 1) web: `cd web && npm install` (after adding drizzle deps), `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`. 2) scraper: add deps to requirements.txt, `./dev.sh lint`, `./dev.sh test`. 3) A Postgres instance must be reachable via DATABASE_URL for integration tests; use a disposable/test database. 4) Drizzle migrations must be generated+applied before either app or SQLAlchemy mapping is exercised. 5) Preserve the demo flow: login demo@fineprint.local/demo1234, 5 insurers, mock brochure source, Verify-chain pass AND a tampered entry fail.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Drizzle generates SQL migration files (e.g. web/drizzle/*.sql) and a journal — these are checked in and must be committed. web/package-lock.json is regenerated by npm install when deps are added — commit it. No other generated artifacts. data/versions/<sourceId>/*.html are runtime binary page snapshots (recommend keep on filesystem, not DB).
environment_constraints: Leave the scraper LLM config ALONE (HERMES_API_KEY, Anthropic LLM_MODEL in docker-compose) — storage only. Mailpit/WEB_BASE_URL/SCRAPER_URL env unchanged. Only ADD DATABASE_URL. Atomic-write guarantees of the old file layer are replaced by DB transactions. Do not push; commit locally only.
contribution_requirements: CLAUDE.md: update TASK.MD when meaningful work completes (append-only). Every (app) page exports `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"` (do not remove). Next 16 dynamic route params are Promise<{...}> — always `await params`. Policy engine, PII blocker, audit chain, quarantine reader are non-negotiable security features — the audit hash chain MUST keep passing Verify-chain and still fail on tamper.
key_patterns: Web storage chokepoint web/src/lib/db.ts exports readJSON/writeJSON/appendJSONL/readJSONL/dataFileExists (SYNC). Converting to Drizzle makes the data layer ASYNC — every call site gets `await`; audit.logEvent becomes async (callers: onboarding route, mail.sendEmail, quote route). Entity source of truth: web/src/lib/types.ts (camelCase). Scraper schemas scraper/app/schemas/*.py are snake_case BUT engine/persona code reads raw camelCase dicts (e.g. source["planIds"]). Pick ONE column convention (recommend snake_case columns with Drizzle camelCase field aliases; SQLAlchemy maps 1:1) and refactor scraper call sites. AUDIT HASH (highest risk): logEvent builds object with EXACT key order timestamp,actor,action,detail,prevHash (no hash field), hash=sha256(JSON.stringify(partial)); verifyChain re-reads in insertion order and recomputes. jsonb does NOT preserve key order/whitespace/number formatting — storing detail as jsonb WILL break the chain. Store the exact serialized JSON text used for hashing (or detail as text) and add a monotonic ordering id; store timestamp as text ISO (not timestamptz). String PKs (aia, user_demo, aia_ci_power) — keep text PKs.
directory_structure: web/src/lib (storage+domain libs), web/src/app/api/** (10 route handlers touching storage), web/src/__tests__ (Jest: policy/audit/blocker + setup.ts), scraper/app/storage (json_store.py live; jsonl_append.py = unused audit mirror), scraper/app/schemas (Pydantic snake_case models), scraper/app/scraper/engine.py (scrape pipeline, writes plans/sources/runs + versions/ HTML), scraper/app/personas/simulator.py (reads/writes threads), scraper/app/routers (scraper.py, email.py), seed/ (source-of-truth JSON + reset.sh), data/ (runtime, gitignored), docker-compose.yml (init-data copies seed JSON -> must become postgres + migrate/seed).
